name: fxmacrodata
description: Official-source FX, macroeconomic and central-bank data: release calendars, actual release times, indicator histories, policy rates, FX rates, COT positioning, commodities, release replays and FX backtests.

interface.shortDescription: Official macro releases, central-bank rates, release calendars and FX rates
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the hosted FXMacroData MCP server: indicator histories and latest prints with actual release times and source links, scheduled release calendars, policy rates, FX rates, COT positioning and commodities, plus release replays, spot FX backtests and a sourced history of maritime, sanctions and conflict-zone events. Data tools are read-only. Research tools save only your own research studies and simulated paper accounts. No tool places live orders, moves money or changes account settings. USD data works without an API key.
defaultPrompt: What was the latest US CPI reading, and when was it actually published?
Build a US macro briefing: rates, inflation, jobs and the releases due next.
Show the US release calendar for this week in my local time.
